body:
Like @Mickeon I think from a UX perspective this leads to an unwanted usability issue. People will generally expect the picker under the resource where they just clicked. If that does and does not happens sometimes, that'll lead to a bad experience.

But I like the functionality of the search though! Can't we somehow merge this dialog with the filtering into the picker? Put a filter box at the top of the picker when there's more than X options? To be clear: I'm not sure if that should be part of this PR or whether that approach warrants a new / different PR. But that sounds like a nice common ground that would probably also not need any of the settings; the list of resources can just but a scrollable list then, too.
